name: marquee
blurb: Content scrolls seamlessly in a continuous loop with optional hover pause.
description: Repeats and scrolls child content in an infinite seamless loop. Supports horizontal and vertical scrolling, pause on hover, and customizable duration and gap via CSS variables.
use_when: Scrolling tag lists, skill showcases, or content carousels that need smooth continuous motion.
avoid_when: Content requiring keyboard pause control — hover pause is available but not keyboard-driven.
a11y: Continuous scrolling can challenge some readers. Pauses on hover but lacks keyboard pause control.
